orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
WPMS No. 3040 of 2019 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Vinod Nautiyal, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the 
respondents. 
Learned counsel for the respondents 
prays for and is granted three weeks’ time to 
file counter affidavit. 
List immediately thereafter. 
Interim order issuing direction to the 
petitioner to seek adjournment before the 
Court below would remain extended till the 
next date of listing. 
The petitioner would be at liberty to file 
adjournment application if any proceeding is 
held prior to the filing of the counter affidavit 
by the respondents. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 13.03.2020
Shiv

07.01.2022 WPMS No. 3040 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for 
the respondents, after seeking a prior consent 
from the petitioner’s counsel, prays for that he 
may be granted three weeks’ time to file counter 
affidavit and the matter may be adjourned and 
posted after winter vacation.
The prayer as sought for is granted.
The writ petition is directed to be 
listing in the week commencing 07.03.2022.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
